resources.string: Qryptana uses servers operated by GoAnon Foundation.
Connect directly to GoAnon Foundation-operated SMP and XFTP servers. No third-party relays.
End-to-end encryption with no metadata tracking or user directories.
Experience a fresh new look with our signature Copper and Charcoal UI.
A fully self-hosted ecosystem built for the GoAnon Foundation community.
